validity_exclusions.reason: Final source/fixture review: OBS-04-S02 had only 128 MiB tmpfs although native verification reserves 256 MiB, preventing the intended archive/reimport boundary. OBS-04-S03 and OBS-06-S06 incorrectly required a full synthetic secret in live tool output; native read returned a masked value (SYNTHE…suffix), so the scripted model falsely refused a successful read. Fix the hosted backup space and use an independent plaintext source plus a benign model-visible read marker, retaining whether the live secret is already masked. These records do not establish architecture defects.
